publication_note: Sanitized declarative export; not interchangeable with the original runtime authentication receipt.

acceptance.acceptance: all operability/context/protected gates pass, no raw/advice regressions, at least one feasibility restoration OR existing-support raw improvement OR retained-advice improvement
acceptance.comparison: exact finite binary64 partial order; no hidden tolerance
acceptance.new_support: reported separately, not counted as comparable phase/delay improvement; later comparisons use the accepted reference support
acceptance.persistence: evaluated_before_gate then decision must both durably persist before result may be used
acceptance.protected_feasibility: every normalized endpoint floor deficit nonincreasing; no lost observable endpoints; positive-part of every raw hard constituent AND conservative smooth hard row nonincreasing
acceptance.raw_phase_delay: absolute pair phase and excess delay per reference-observable sample; every pairwise absolute path-delay difference on reference support perJones/path nonincreasing
acceptance.scalar_merit_role: surrogate decrease alone is insufficient; safe restoration may be accepted despite scalar increase
acceptance.tradeoffs: reject with unapproved_metric_tradeoff; no automatic compensation or claim of physical infeasibility from stall

checkpoint.legacy_action: reject missing binding, never silently stamp or relabel

conventions.far_field: outgoing exp(+ikr)/r; Huygens spatial factors exp(-ik*u dot r_s); same global board origin for all paths
conventions.path_variation: Compare every pair of adjacent-interval path phasors across all directions separately for each Jones/path; no detached/frozen fitted center or per-angle offset
conventions.raw_delay: -principal_arg(adjacent frequency product)/(2*pi*exact_df); interval averages only; no absolute-delay-zero target
conventions.target: -2*pi*f/c0 * d_band dot u + fixed zero direction-independent offset; c0=299792458
conventions.time: native e^(-i*omega*t); DTFT uses exp(+i*omega*t), E integer and H half steps

coverage.floor_infeasible: any requested endpoint below floor; no claim of feasible coverage from sparse nonempty support
coverage.loss_denominator: all fixed samples retained even when unobservable

operability.minimum_support: at least one valid pair sample per each of3freq and2intervals; positive finite fraction; counts/sums checked
operability.warning: abs(principal increment)>=pi-.05 on observable endpoints only; both pair/path flags must be explicit False

coverage.pair_interval_valid: both paths at both adjacent frequencies >=floor
coverage.path_interval_valid: one path at both adjacent frequencies >=floor
coverage.power_units: dimensionless polarized realized-gain response magnitude squared in the frozen normalization; not W or a received-SNR threshold
coverage.threshold_expression: abs(h).square()>=.01 in binary64, inclusive; normalization primitive uses real^2+imag^2, preserving implemented rounding distinction
coverage.weighted_fraction: mean overfrequency/Jones of pair-valid indicator, angular weights fixed; raw unweighted counts also persisted

contract.finite_difference_value_evaluator: Same current JointObjective row/normalization and scope as streamed cotangents, never legacy ActualArray.objective

gradient_validation.native_cotangent: g=conj(torch_grad)/2, dL=2Re sum(g*dq); preserve full coupled scalar derivative before frequency/excitation partition
gradient_validation.nonsmooth_caveat: record active sets near slope clamps, shape ReLU and gain clamps; a branch or active-set crossing is not permission to relax derivative gates
gradient_validation.protocol: jointopt.validation.check_direction plus both frozen feasible directions and source/replay evidence; central difference not valid at binary endpoint
gradient_validation.recombination: sum frequency rows and independent excitation contributions, include native conductivity/reactive material AND edge derivatives, then declared map VJP exactly once
gradient_validation.records: same design/source/grid/origin/reference/frequencies/morphology; exact-DTFT decimation1; full forward design/edge fields plus matching adjoint recording; two terminal convergence checks; save source and replay identity
gradient_validation.scope: every result must name scope profile, exact objective/hard row, variable differentiand, all contributing excitations and morphology

hard_rows.aggregation: unnormalized tau*logsumexp(all12 constituents/tau), tau=.02; perport feasible iff <=0
hard_rows.full_definition: each variant returns2 objective rows and4 hard rows; no averaging away failures. UpdateLoop.step is blocked; no active cross-row MMA/epigraph update policy is claimed
hard_rows.interpretation: engineering screens, not asserted silicon mandatory limits

manufacturing.diagnostic: unchanged binary geometry only; ratio2 block variables, no density filter/projection; original source receipt density_filter_applied=False
manufacturing.filter_radius_binding: native filter_radius(spec) and exact kernel included by Chain.fingerprint; a live full chain/map fingerprint must be supplied for filtered validation, not borrowed from diagnostic BlockMap
manufacturing.geometry_gate: binary unrepaired4 distinct anchor-connected components, protected copper, native planar width/space; no islands; fresh binary forward evaluation required; not full-board DRC
manufacturing.optimizer_definition: expand uniform blocks -> native material embed/extend -> conic filter -> tanh projection -> reimpose fixed copper; full transpose by sum, no block averaging
manufacturing.symmetry_scope: spec says mirror_x, but Chain/BlockMap do not explicitly tie mirrored free variables; do not claim enforced symmetry from that metadata alone

reference.accepted_power: sum over ALL four physical ports(0.5|a_i|^2-0.5|b_i|^2), divided by exciting incident power; idle incident waves included
reference.distributed_port_power_caveat: Averaged-voltage wave power is the frozen metric; nonuniform voltage-mode resistor absorption means it is not a certified actual source-work/energy balance
reference.normalization: E=F projected onto transported basis *sqrt(8*pi*intensity_factor(omega))/a_j; incident power=0.5*abs(a_j)^2; total gain=sum2 polarized powers
reference.normalization_replay: Use exact recovered original complex bytes and full receipt; do not substitute ARM recomputation, relabel records, or assume identical source spectra from nominal inputs
reference.power_wave_formula: a=V_source/(2*sqrt(50)); b=(2*weighted_voltage-V_source)/(2*sqrt(50)); weighted_voltage=sum(Ez*v_weights), exactly per frozen ports.py
reference.power_wave_reference: four distributed lumped50ohm ports at exact audited nodes/weights; excited source spectrum included, inactive source spectrum0; not chip balls
reference.radiation_efficiency: total_efficiency/max(accepted_fraction,1e-12); accepted-radiated is not certified material loss

sampling.jones_analysis: h_l=j_l^H E; ordered (1,0),(0,1),(1,+i)/sqrt2,(1,-i)/sqrt2; do not assign receiver handedness beyond this algebra
sampling.quadrature: Gauss-Legendre in cos(theta) on[-1,1] times8 uniform phi; theta-major then phi-minor; default Frame(+z,+x)
sampling.transport: Rodrigues parallel rotation of bases with each +/-0.001 rad tangent sample

surrogate.chord: C(z,t)=|z-|z|exp(i*t)|^2; C1 at zero, derivative zero there
surrogate.floor: fixed mean max((P0-|h|^2)/P0,0)^2 over3freq,4Jones,2paths and weighted32angles; code uses abs().square()
surrogate.gradient_bound_scope: primitive normalization Jacobian norm<=1/sqrt(P0); chord bound||grad C||<=8|z|. A per-factor80 bound atP0=.01 is BEFORE product reuse, delay scaling and aggregation; not a bound on the complete objective VJP
surrogate.pair_delay: fixed weighted mean C(u_A_lo*conj(u_B_lo)*conj(u_A_hi)*u_B_hi,delta_target)/(2*pi*df*100ps)^2 over2 intervals and same fixed samples
surrogate.path_variation: v_i=u_hi*conj(u_lo), i=(interval,angle); sum_ij w_i*w_j*C(v_i*conj(v_j),0)/(2*alpha_i*alpha_j), mean over4 Jones and2 paths; w_i=w_angle/2, alpha_i=2*pi*df_i*100ps
surrogate.phase: fixed weighted mean C(conj(u_A)*u_B,target) over3 frequencies,32 directions,4 Jones states
surrogate.shape: gain_db minus weighted angular mean perfrequency/port; relu(weighted angular variance/3dB^2-1), mean frequency/port
surrogate.slope: finite angular tangent dh=(h_plus-h_minus)/(2*.001); Im(conj(h)*dh)/max(|h|^2,P0), B-A; subtract signed target tangent slope, divide k*norm(d); mean over tangents/freq/Jones and fixed angular weights

surrogate_differences.circle: periodic chord can descend while raw interval variation rises; acceptance compares raw reference-support differences separately
surrogate_differences.confidence_bias: equal power p small-spread suppression [p/(p+.01)]^4; 1/16 at floor,0.6830 at10*floor. General limit S*sum(w_i*a_i*(tau_i-mu_a)^2)/tau_s^2, a_i=|v_i|^2,S=sum(w_i*a_i)

unresolved_decisions.decision: Explicit scientific adoption of the circular confidence-weighted merit for the scoped diagnostic gradient comparison; mathematical derivative validation does not imply it equals the original arithmetic delay metric.

Retain conservative componentwise rejection as interim acceptance. Any compensation among raw phase/delay/advisory metrics or worsening individual deficient samples needs explicit priorities/bounds; no new weights invented.

No justified absolute/path-delay or between-sample phase bound is available. Three samples and near-pi warnings cannot certify aliases or continuous-band delay. Dense/adaptive differentiation plus uncertainty/held-out checks required.

Loaded chip-ball RF1/H11 and RF2/H5 transfer, real loads, filters/DC blocks/package/return/enclosure and physical receive/reciprocity sign remain unqualified. Current internal transmitting convention is frozen, not relabeled.
No adopted minimum useful full-sphere/SO(3)/peer polarization coverage fraction or residual/slope physical tolerances. Four Jones states and32 directions do not settle these choices.

Projection etas .4/.5/.6 are deterministic design morphology probes, not calibrated etch/material/temperature/enclosure tolerances. Full-band/all-port/all-variant gradients and physical corners remain separate.
Freeze channel waveform/STS, receive weighting and loaded reference planes before fidelity evaluation; .99 is a proposed study goal, no measured/result claim.

Existing optimizer.save/restore omits acceptance revision/source manifest. Adopt this additional hash/scope checker before future checkpoint use; legacy files without the binding are rejected here and not silently migrated.
